item.tib: stong gsum 'khrugs bcos snang srid rgyan mdos kyi bca' thabs lha yi sgron ma
item.coloph: zhes de ltar bca' thabs lag len rgyas par bshad pa de nyid/ rig 'dzin chen po kun grol gsang ba rtsal nyid kyis 'di ltar dgos zhes bkas gnang ba theb pa/ zhang zhung sgo phyogs mdo khams khyung po'i tha grur skyes pa/ ldong rigs blo gros seng ger 'bod pas bkod pa la/ phyis bcos 'bum bkra shis pa'i snying po'i mdo yi mchod bstod rgyas pa zhu dag gi tshul du a yu rdor dzas bgyis pa mu tsug smar ro//
